_about: OFFICE MEMO set 2 of 4 (Phase B memo pool, narrative design 2026-10-30; research/narrative/70_terminal_strings.md section 6). Same as the v1 set (interoffice.json) except the two memos: the newer one (this month) first, the older one (four months back) second, one from R.M. and one from D.K. The print queue is the building-wide MAIN queue and is the same on every set. Packaging for the deal (20_design section 8.5: seed-keyed permutation, no repeats in a run) is the terminal owner's: e.g. Resources/Terminal/Content/terminal_<key>.json. Plain ASCII only. Tokens: see FrontRoomsTerminalContent.cs.
